user.title: Add a tracked entity
user.description: Choose the entity you want Whodidit to monitor. A diagnostic sensor will be created and attached to its device page.

options.title: Physical interaction (optional)
options.description: Optionally add a binary sensor that turns ON when a physical interaction is detected on this entity, plus a click counter. Leave the sensors empty for time-only reset.

error.unsupported_domain: This entity's domain is not supported by Whodidit.
error.already_tracked: This entity is already tracked by another Whodidit sensor.

init.title: Physical interaction
init.description: Enable or reconfigure the physical-interaction binary sensor for this entity.

reset_physical_interaction.name: Reset physical interaction
reset_physical_interaction.description: Force the physical-interaction binary sensor OFF and clear the click counter.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: The tracked entity or the physical-interaction binary sensor.

update_options.name: Update options
update_options.description: Update the physical-interaction options of the entry that owns the given entity (used by the Whodidit card).

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: The tracked entity or any Whodidit entity of the target entry.

options.name: Options
options.description: Partial options object to merge into the entry.
